content.short: Perpetuals exchange for crypto and tokenized stocks and ETFs, with copy trading.
content.description: Flipster lists more than 240 perpetual markets, mixing crypto pairs with TradFi contracts on stocks and ETFs such as Coinbase and leveraged semiconductor funds, with up to 75x leverage on some assets. Traders can copy master traders' strategies, and margin balances earn up to 6% APR while they sit in open positions. Weekly trading competitions add rewards.
content.meta: Trade 240+ crypto and stock perpetuals on Flipster, copy top traders, and earn APR on margin while you trade.
